newsitem.title: USA: Mercury Finance shares indicated at $2-$4.
newsitem.headline: Mercury Finance shares indicated at $2-$4.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said shares of Mercury Finance Co were indicated at between $2 and $4 for their opening on Friday after the company discovered bookkeeping problems that, it said, caused it to overstate earnings by $90 million.
Shares closed at 14-7/8 on Wednesday. Trading was halted by the NYSE and did not trade yesterday.

Mercury Finance had also said it chief accountant, James Doyle, had disappeared. His lawyer told the Wall Street Journal on Friday that Doyle denies Mercury's and that he is cooperating with federal officials.
